sprint.objective: Implement an approved merchant barcode/POS increment while preserving backend authority and offline recovery contracts.

justifications.apps/merchant-app/package.json: Only if the approved POS design requires a reviewed direct dependency; lockfile must change with it.
justifications.backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/: Only a forward migration may be added when the approved backend contract requires persistence.

workers.objective: Implement any approved server-authoritative barcode/POS contract and its backend tests.
repository_facts: The Kotlin/Spring backend is the business authority.
acceptance_criteria: API and persistence invariants are enforced by executable tests.
evidence_requirements: Record exact-head exit codes and log hashes for required checks.

workers.objective: Implement the scoped merchant barcode/POS UI and offline-safe workflow.
repository_facts: The Merchant app uses Expo 56 and an independent npm lockfile.
Offline commands must remain partitioned and recoverable.
acceptance_criteria: Barcode/POS behavior passes route, type, lint, and test gates without demo-only fallback.
evidence_requirements: Capture check output and identify device-only evidence that remains manual.

workers.objective: Review scope, dependency changes, cross-stack contracts, and exact-head evidence.
repository_facts: A passing check requires executed evidence; blocked device evidence is not a pass.
acceptance_criteria: Scope and dependency reports are reviewed and every required check is evidence-backed.
evidence_requirements: Report failures and repairs; never fabricate physical-device evidence.

functional: Approved barcode/POS behavior is usable in the Merchant app and server-authoritative where required.
regression: Merchant route, offline, contract, and backend checks pass as selected.
security: Tenant/outlet boundaries and input validation are exercised; no secrets enter evidence.
contracts: Any API or schema change is forward-compatible and tested on affected sides.
